method: Same CUDA graph measurement, randomized order, approximately 50ms warmup before every sample. Same tiles, stages, G=1. All outputs preallocated. Unlocked clocks.

layout.normalization: Row/N32 exponent-max reduction and BF16x2 multiply occur before MOVM, preserving the original row scale without shuffling scales.
layout.transpose: Each BF16 8x8 quadrant is transposed by MOVM, then converted to E4M3. Pack transposed TL/TR into one m16n8 source and BL/BR into another.
layout.store: STMATRIX m16n8.trans transposes each packed source back to an 8x16 row-major output. Four source registers store one 16x32 tile; address lanes unchanged from M8N8 path.
layout.instruction_delta_per_16x32: 8 SHFL.IDX -> 8 MOVM.16.MT88; 4 fewer PRMT; STSM.16.M88.4 -> STSM.8.MT168.4. Scale reduction SHFL.BFLY unchanged.

default: Unchanged SHFL/M8N8 path. Build a separate library with build(output=..., movmatrix=True) to enable the experiment.
